summary: Independent review of task 17.3 (read-only diagnostics status panel on the embedded settings page, Phase 17 / goal F3 / ADR-025 clauses 2-5). Approved. The page addition implements the ADR-025 clause 2 panel correctly: one elevation-gated GET ArrTags/Status via ApiClient, rendering the fixed 28-leaf counter set derived from DiagnosticsSnapshot/MatchingFailureCounts/RenderFailureCounts/ArrConnectionHealth; fail-closed rendering (static-hidden empty container, object-only guard, rejection and caught-exception clears, bounded 0/Unknown fallbacks, no response string in the DOM); no form control, configuration property, write verb, polling/retry, or save-path change; and PascalCase/string-enum response paths that match the endpoint wire format (verified against JsonDefaults.Options and the pinned host web-client bundle). I re-ran the build (0 warnings / 0 errors), the focused class (Failed 0 / Passed 6), and the full default suite (Failed 0 / Passed 1794 / Skipped 64 / Total 1858); ARRTAGS_JELLYFIN_HOST_DIR is unset so the 64 host-guarded skips are unchanged and not claimed as passes. I independently reproduced five worker probes in an isolated worktree (route drift, raw count reader, added <input>, removed display:none, dropped clear calls); each failed exactly the intended test and the page was restored byte-identically. Documentation/state is consistent (changelog entry, PLANS.md checkbox 17.3, state.json done/reports/updated_utc); Phase 17 remains PLANNED and no gate/tag was applied.

findings.summary: The panel's inline JavaScript is verified structurally, not executed at runtime.
findings.detail: The repository has no JavaScript runtime and the pinned live matrix runs --nowebclient, so the fetch/render/DOM behavior cannot be executed here. This is a real residual, but it is inherent to the existing settings-page-test style, is honestly disclosed in the worker report's known_limitations and the changelog, and the plan assigns the F3 security review (task 17.4) to adjudicate it. Independently corroborated the load-bearing runtime assumption against the pinned host bundle: ApiClient.ajax delegates to fetch (key:"ajax",value:function(e,t){return e?this.fetch(e,t):...}); fetch rejects on status >= 400 and on dataType 'json' parse failure (t.status<400?...?t.json():t:Promise.reject(t)); and ApiClient.getUrl prepends the server address with a '/' separator (key:"getUrl" ... n=r||this._serverAddress ... n+='/' ...).
findings.recommended_action: No change required for 17.3; leave the residual to the plan-assigned 17.4 security review.

findings.summary: Panel response paths are PascalCase and health values are string enum names; verified against the pinned host JSON options.
findings.detail: The page indexes QueueDepth, MatchingFailures.NotFound, RenderFailures.<reason>, SonarrHealth, etc., and compares health against the enum names. This only works if the endpoint serializes PascalCase with string enums. I confirmed: (a) JsonDefaults.Options.PropertyNamingPolicy is null, i.e. PascalCase (pinned by ConfigurationRoundTripTests.PinnedPostDeserializationOptionsArePascalCase and docs/research/jellyfin-12-architecture.md 9.3); (b) the passing 17.2 test SerializedSnapshotCarriesExactlyTheFixedCounterPathsAndNoStringArrayOrSecretCarrier serializes the snapshot with JsonDefaults.Options and reads SonarrHealth via GetString() == 'Healthy', so enums are string-serialized; (c) the 17.2 MVC harness mirrors the host by copying that naming policy and adding JsonStringEnumConverter. The page table matches those names exactly.
findings.recommended_action: None; recorded so the dependency is not re-litigated.

per_criterion_verification.criterion: 2. Fail-closed: rejected/unauthorized (401/403), unavailable (404/500), or malformed body renders no data and no error surface; the served page starts hidden/empty.
per_criterion_verification.evidence:
The panel div is
; diagnosticsLoad calls diagnosticsClearPanel() before the request; the success then-handler is wrapped in try/catch that clears; the second then argument clears; diagnosticsRenderPanel returns early unless the body is a non-array object; diagnosticsClearPanel writes only textContent='' and display='none'. The pinned web client's fetch rejects on status >= 400 and on dataType 'json' parse failure, so none of 401/403/404/500/malformed reaches the render. Probes C (drop clears) and G (remove display:none) each failed PageFailsClosedWhenTheRequestIsRejectedOrTheBodyIsMalformed exactly.

per_criterion_verification.criterion: 4. Secret-free; no free-form response string rendered (only bounded counts/bounded enum names from a fixed table; safe fallbacks for missing fields).

per_criterion_verification.criterion: 5. Structural tests genuinely pin the behavior and are meaningful; probes credible.
